title: 阿里云百炼的qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507模型缺少参数enable_thinking为True而无法调用
body:
### 📦 部署环境

Docker

### 📦 部署模式

服务端模式(lobe-chat-database 镜像)

### 📌 软件版本

v1.106.3

### 💻 系统环境

Windows

### 🌐 浏览器

Chrome

### 🐛 问题描述

阿里云百炼的`qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507`模型缺少参数`enable_thinking`为`True`而无法调用


### 📷 复现步骤

交互时弹出如下错误`The value of the enable_thinking parameter is restricted to True`：
```
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_parameter_error",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "Provider API error: <400> InternalError.Algo.InvalidParameter: The value of the enable_thinking parameter is restricted to True. (request id: 20250730xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx)"
  },
  "endpoint": "***/v1",
  "provider": "qwen"
}
```

### 🚦 期望结果

可以正常调用

### 📝 补充信息

_No response_

ai_judgment.response: Yes, this is an agent issue. The problem involves an incompatible parameter (`enable_thinking`) required for invoking the `qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507` model from the LLM provider, which aligns with the "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" sub-category.
